name: quioteframework/cloud-azure
description: Minimal Azure Blob and Table Storage clients, Shared Key or Azure AD (workload identity / az login) authenticated REST access with no azure-sdk dependency, plus a signed-request method for operations they do not model themselves. Framework-agnostic (built on quioteframework/storage, not the Quiote framework itself) and usable outside a Quiote application; also shared by Quiote's own Azure session and filesystem backends.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/cloud-azure/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
